name: crypsy-note
description: Client-side AES-256-GCM encrypted quick-notes and free-form spatial boards web app with Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) folder installer

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:js && node install.js --build-only
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npm run cap:prepare && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
